title: Laddu
desc: A group of friends enjoys life in the countryside before moving to the city. Their life takes a chaotic turn when they encounter a girl and a priceless relic, leading to a race to secure both.

title: Jogi
desc: After a crime lord is murdered by Madesha, Nivedhitha, a journalist, sets out to meet him. She ends up meeting an old woman and promises to help her find her son, who is none other than Madesha.

title: F3: Fun and Frustration
desc: Venky and Varun brainstorm various strategies to overcome their economic challenges. However, complications arise when they cross paths with a businessman.

title: Bheema Theeradalli
desc: Chandappa, a dreaded dacoit, gets deceived by a corrupt politician, Shashikanth. But fate intervenes when the latter's sister ends up falling in love with Chandappa.

title: Inspector Vijay
desc: Vijay, an honest police officer, meets Samyukta at a cafe and falls in love with her. However, his life changes when he witnesses a kidnapping and ends up helping a lonely woman, Lavanya.

title: DD Returns
desc: An event manager and his friends hide the money they stole in a haunted bungalow to evade the police but when they go back to retrieve it, the ghosts force them to play a dangerous game.
